Book correction: In Figure 11.2 the scale on the z-axis is printed (from the top) 3500, 3000, 25000, 20000, 15000, 10000, 5000, 0. The marks go up in equal steps of 5000 km, so the top two should read 35000 and 30000 (one zero is missing in each). Our figure uses the correct scale; it runs up to 40000 km because at t = 4\pi the height is 3000 \times 4\pi \approx 37699 km.
